title: Spectral bounds and their limits in Pauli contextuality: exact configurations and a proof of Jonah's Conjecture E
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; listed on ORCID)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
core_result: Unified study with complete Lean 4.35.0 formalizations of the spectral floor (Theorem 1), Theorem 2 (Kramers / quaternionic floor and elliptic quadrics Q-(2N-1,2)), Theorems 3-4 (5-way saturation equivalences and (2^N-1)|S| = square), exact contextuality degrees (75, 480, 729344) for 4-, 5-, and 7-qubit configurations, a four-qubit cospectral C3 pair with distinct completion spectra (Theorem 14) and separated binary completion minima (Corollary 16: <=344 < 347), general cone lift and case C11 from C3 (Corollary 18), Lemmas 20-21, Theorem 22 (universal cubic-trace identity) and Table 8 outside character sums, and Theorem 19: a full machine-checked Lean 4 proof of Jonah's Conjecture E across all nine vertex cases (C1, C3, C5, C6, C8, C11, C12, C14, C15) for every N >= 4 (plus N >= 3 for C1, C3, C6, C11), accompanied by 97 exact integer checks of Theorem 22.
verification_boundary: As of v1.6.0, the spectral floor, Kramers quaternionic floor, 5-way saturation equivalences, saturated configurations (75, 480, 729344), four-qubit C3 spectral certificate (42 decls) and binary minima separation (Corollary 16), all-qubit C3 family (74 decls), general cone lift and case C11 (Corollary 18), Lemmas 20-21, Theorem 22 (universal cubic-trace identity), and Theorem 19 (Jonah's Conjecture E in all 9 vertex cases for every N >= 4) are all kernel-checked in Lean 4.35.0 (49 audited declarations in VerifyNewFormalizations.lean, 7,686 new library lines, zero sorry, zero native_decide, strictly standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). Remaining outside Lean: state-to-mask identifications of Table 1, Propositions 3, 4, 6 and 8-11, exhaustive enumerations of Theorems 12-13, printed C3 factorizations and relaxation gap 32, and Clifford orbit transport across hyperplane classes via Jonah [J3, Theorem B4]. Historical source manuscripts remain preserved inside the repository as component records of this single combined study (see publication/PAPER-MAP.md).
